verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline dominant and puts the two info boxes together on one baseline in the original order, but the blue box copy is tiny next to the black box text, and the boxes crowd the bottom edge. B's headline is undersized, and the blue box body copy is nearly as large as the headline, so it competes for attention. B also swaps the reading order (black box first), lets the small black box float at an arbitrary spot just under the headline with its left edge out of line, and leaves dead space on the left middle.
